items.subject: Greenwood Creek shoreline takeout
items.nextAction: Keep the BLM approximate parking marker. Research an agency landing coordinate or review a community pin against the BLM carry-trail map and imagery before moving it.

items.subject: North Beach / Coloma extension
items.nextAction: Confirm the current launch arrangement and obtain a source-backed area or landing coordinate. The 2024 plan is preliminary, not proof new ramps were built. Current State Parks guidance prohibits commercial takeout, with limited commercial launch exceptions. Do not infer a blanket takeout restriction from older map copies.
